cases.stdout:
usage: lcr [-h]
           {doctor,setup,prepare,build,corpus,probe,oracle,perf,report,status,worklist,brief,summary,show,table,review,wpt,realworld,spec-coverage,clean,baseline,selftest,validate-probes} ...

lcr: deterministic review harness for parcel-bundler/lightningcss pull
requests.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,setup,prepare,build,corpus,probe,oracle,perf,report,status,worklist,brief,summary,show,table,review,wpt,realworld,spec-coverage,clean,baseline,selftest,validate-probes}
    doctor              check host requirements and images
    setup               build Docker images (builder + browser engines) and
                        record versions
    prepare             resolve PR -> base/head trees, classify the change
    build               fmt check, inject recorder, cargo test (both sides),
                        build adapters
    corpus              assemble cases (tests, probes, WPT, real-world), run
                        base/head adapters, compute deltas
    probe               run the agent-written probes in <run>/probes through
                        both adapters
    oracle              run browser oracles on deltas, PR tests and probes
    perf                optional: release-build timing on the real-world
                        corpus and binary size, base vs head
    report              compute verdict and render report.md/report.json from
                        the templates
    status              show stage status for a run
    worklist            write/refresh analysis.json with every slot the report
                        needs; print the open ones
    brief               compact digest of a run for the reviewer (instead of
                        raw JSON)
    summary             print the fixed chat summary for a reported run
    show                print one case: input, base/head output, per-engine
                        oracle diffs
    table               one line per oracle case: transition, base/head
                        status, bad engines, legacy (before the oracle:
                        outputs only)
    review              prepare + build + corpus (stops before the agent
                        analysis step)
    wpt                 fetch the pinned WPT revision and extract the parsing
                        corpus
    realworld           download the pinned real-world CSS corpus
    spec-coverage       webref inventory vs. what LightningCSS parses (missing
                        features)
    clean               delete old runs; with <run> drop its build trees;
                        --results drops raw oracle results
    baseline            run every curated probe on current master through the
                        oracle
    selftest            run the oracle's known-answer cases in every engine
                        profile
    validate-probes     parse every probe file and report format errors
